text:
kim: heads-up - eu-west1c showing attach failures with 'no scratch slots' and nvme latencies climbing quickly. users reporting queued jobs.
ops-bot: ALERT: eu-west1c scratch_iops_utilization 93% for 6m. attach_fail_rate 11%.
rahul: looking. `iostat -x 1 3` shows nvme0n1 util ~99%, avg await 80-150ms. appears to coincide with a wave of short lived GPU jobs + janitor scrub starting. scrub jitter for this pool is at 0 (we disabled for a prior test).
tia: if jitter is 0 we get a fanout when a bunch of nodes scrub at the same second. quick fix: reduce janitor concurrency and enable jitter. also temp gate attaches to nodes with free_scratch_slots >= 4.
mike: can we also prefer other regions for non-latency-sensitive batches while we stabilize? small cost hit but reduces pressure.
rahul: commands I'm about to run on control plane:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap janitor-config --patch '{"data":{"concurrency":"1","scrubJitterSeconds":"600"}}'
curl -X POST https://provisioner.internal/_admin/policies -d '{"expr":"free_scratch_slots>=4"}'
```
ops-bot: CHANGE: janitor concurrency set to 1 by rahul at 4365000152. rollback scheduled at 4365000512 if attach_error_rate increases.
kim: roll canary first then stagger AZs. monitor attach queue and per-node nvme await.
rahul: canary done, attach queue down 180->32 in 50s. rolling to other AZs with 20s spacing.
tia: post-incident: add pre-scale validation to block janitor windows within 10m of autoscale events and a permanent alert if scrubJitter==0. owner: infra/storage.
mike: noted. also file RFC to add per-node iops_budget to the provisioner so admission can be smarter than just slot counts.
kim: thanks all. keeping thread for final postmortem items. :thumbsup:
